<description>
The existing "Duplicate inputs" case only has two inputs, so the duplicate is always the last one. This PR adds a case with inputs A, A, B so that the duplicate-input check in `CheckTransaction` is exercised when the duplicate is not the last input.

It kills the following mutant (https://mutanthub.space/mutants/4676):

```diff
diff --git a/src/consensus/tx_check.cpp b/src/consensus/tx_check.cpp
index 473538e4fe..3cbda6c0aa 100644
--- a/src/consensus/tx_check.cpp
+++ b/src/consensus/tx_check.cpp
@@ -48,7 +48,7 @@ bool CheckTransaction(const CTransaction& tx, TxValidationState& state)
     // the underlying coins database.
     std::set<COutPoint> vInOutPoints;
     for (const auto& txin : tx.vin) {
-        if (!vInOutPoints.insert(txin.prevout).second)
+        if (!vInOutPoints.insert(txin.prevout).second && &txin == &tx.vin.back())
             return state.Invalid(TxValidationResult::TX_CONSENSUS, "bad-txns-inputs-duplicate");
     }
```
</description>
